integrity: Exact analytical proof with finite, independently executable diagnostic script. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed parameters; only the Laplace exponent has an asymptotic Schatten prefactor for all p, while the quadratic exponent has exact theta formulas; rates for general exponents beyond leading logarithmic norm are not claimed. title: Two-scale Aluthge asymptotics of compact bilateral stretched-exponential shifts
